full_prompt_en: A nocturnal photographic scene shows a tree engulfed by bright fire near its base, with a tiny solitary figure silhouetted in front of the blaze. The tree stands near the centre of a low, dark field beneath a deep navy-black sky. White-yellow flames gather around the lower trunk and rise into the lower branches, becoming orange at their edges. Parts of the branching crown remain visible as warm brown shapes extending to the right of the brighter column. Above the flames, a tall plume of golden embers scatters upwards, densely clustered near the fire and thinning into isolated points higher in the frame. A faint brown-grey smoke cloud softens the transition into the night. The small upright person appears close to the lower centre against the bright base; no facial features or clothing details can be resolved. A narrow orange band illuminates the ground behind and around this silhouette, while the foreground remains almost entirely dark. The surrounding field has little visible detail, and no clear buildings compete with the central event. The fire itself supplies the light, producing intense warm highlights against broad cool shadow. The brightest core is compact, while the sparks and partially lit canopy spread the visual movement upwards and outwards. Subtle variations of indigo and charcoal keep the sky from becoming a completely flat black field. The low horizon leaves ample space above the tree, emphasizing the height of the rising embers. The nearly central burning form, tiny still silhouette and expansive darkness create a solemn, elemental composition with a strong contrast of scale and illumination.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅夜间摄影场景，一棵树的基部被明亮火焰包围，火前映出一个微小孤身人影。树位于低矮暗地的中央附近，上方是深藏蓝近黑夜空。白黄色火焰聚在下部树干周围，升入低枝，边缘转为橙色。部分枝冠仍作为暖棕形状在亮火柱右侧伸展。火焰上方，金色余烬组成高高烟羽，近火处密集，越往高处越稀疏成独立亮点，淡棕灰烟雾柔化它们与夜空之间的交界。微小直立人物在下方中央附近衬着亮基部显出，面部与衣服细节无法辨认。一道窄橙光照亮剪影身后及周围地面，前景则几乎全暗。周围原野只有极少可见细节，没有清楚建筑与中央事件争夺注意。火本身提供照明，使强暖亮部对照宽阔冷影。最亮内核紧凑，火星与局部受光树冠则把视觉动势引向上方和两侧。靛蓝与炭灰细微起伏使夜空不成为全平黑色域。低地平线在树上方留下充足空间，强调火星上升高度。近中央燃烧形体、微小静止剪影和广阔黑暗形成庄严而原初的构图，尺度与照明反差鲜明。
style_prompt_en: The style sets intense warm illumination against broad, cool darkness. Bright regions move from pale yellow through orange and amber, then fade quickly into deep navy or charcoal surroundings. Small luminous flecks create vertical movement, while a low band of reflected light anchors the frame near its base. Soft haze blurs the transition around the brightest area, keeping edges atmospheric rather than sharply cut. Large dark negative space heightens the impact of scattered highlights. A simple central arrangement and clear differences in scale give the image a solemn, elemental mood. The visual effect depends on the distance between concentrated light and surrounding shadow.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风格将强烈暖光置于宽阔冷暗空间之前。明亮区域由浅黄过渡至橙色和琥珀色，再迅速融入深海军蓝或炭灰背景。细小发光点带来向上动势，靠近画面底部的窄窄反光带则稳定构图。柔和薄雾模糊最亮区域周围的过渡，使边缘保留氛围感而非锐利切割。大面积暗色负空间强化散布亮点的视觉力度。简洁的中央布局和清晰的尺度差异带来庄严、原初的气氛。整体效果来自集中光线与周围阴影之间的距离。
theme_en: A lone person stands before a towering tree-shaped blaze as sparks rise through a dark night sky
theme_zh: 一名孤身人物站在高耸树形火焰前，火星升入深暗夜空
name: Firelit
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
